entries.text: Redshift and Snowflake build `CREATE TABLE` text through `translate_ddl` instead of the adapters' own DDL rewriters, which are deleted. Redshift still adds `DISTSTYLE AUTO SORTKEY AUTO` and Snowflake still writes `CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE`. Snowflake keeps the case of quoted identifiers instead of upper-casing them, and fixed-size arrays are written as plain arrays.
